title: Lukoil's Balkans Refinery Sale Window Closes Without a Deal
description: The sale window for Lukoil's Balkans refinery has closed without a deal, as reported by EURACTIV. The US has extended the deadline for Lukoil's asset sales until August 22, according to Moldova 1.

sections.heading: Sale Window Closure
paragraphs: According to EURACTIV, the sale window for Lukoil's Balkans refinery, which is the largest in the region, has closed without a deal being finalized.

sections.heading: US Extension on Asset Sales
paragraphs: Moldova 1 reports that the US has extended the deadline for Lukoil to sell its assets until August 22.

sections.heading: Context of Lukoil Waiver Extension
paragraphs: Novinite.com mentions that the US extension of the Lukoil waiver comes after talks between Radev and Wright on energy matters.
